name: 37745 · Greeneville, TN
findings: ZIP 37745 (Greeneville) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37745 (Greeneville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 37745 (Greeneville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
